aluminum_melting_1.name: Melting of Aluminum - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1.description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Monitor the Al–Al bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase transition where the first RDF peak shows a significant increase, defined as more than 10% compared to the initial value. Report the average Al–Al bond length in the molten state in Å.
